name: Locus of Pain
disable: DC 27 Medicine check (master) to soothe the locus's pain, DC 30 Occultism check or DC 30 Religion check to counteract the locus's energies, DC 35 Thievery check (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.
routine: (1 action; mental, nonlethal) Creatures affected by the haunt's agony lash are wracked with pain, as 4th-rank Phantom Pain (DC 32 Will save). If a creature falls Unconscious due to the haunt, they don't continue taking damage.

items.name: Agony Lash
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the orb or attempts to disable the haunt

---
Effect All living creatures within 60 feet are overwhelmed by pain and must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude save save or be Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

items.name: Pain Manifest
items.text: Casting Calm or Soothe in the orb's presence automatically destroys the locus; other spells or abilities that ease pain might also do so, at GM discretion.

items.name: Unholy Repair
items.text: The locus is sustained by the power of Tar-Baphon. The orb regains 10 Hit Points at the beginning of every round and is repaired by void damage.

text: An arcane orb sits upon a sinister altar, filling creatures in the area with unimaginable pain.
